source_notes.wild_east_brooklyn_ny: Current November 2026 normal HTML supplies four complete future dated program lines. Closed Lectures on Tap and a music festival with no clock are held.
source_notes.sip_and_play_brooklyn_ny: Seven explicit weekly programs. Full paragraph boundaries retain named Instagram link text. Monday MTG 6:30 omits a meridian, resolved as 18:30 from official Monday opening hours 11am-11pm; this is a reviewed inference, not invented source text. Wednesday Commander header/body disagree; three biweekly groups lack an anchor; Family Fridays is only a promotion.
source_notes.nyc_pauper_league_ny: The independent official organizer is linked from the Hex publisher ecosystem. Current Season 7 and two holiday breaks are explicit. Three NYC venues accepted, Jersey City excluded. Both Hex venues and Brooklyn Strategist use their exact current addresses, including 148 Pierrepont Street.
source_notes.bronx_alehouse_bronx_ny: The organizer calendar explicitly advertises its TEC venue API. Nine full descriptions include the correct 10463 ZIP, repairing its malformed structured venue ZIP NY. Native UTC and America/New_York times agree. Current venue weekly page independently confirms Tuesday 7pm trivia.
source_notes.os_nyc_new_york_ny: The actual /events page is an active normal Squarespace calendar; /event-calendar is an empty legacy page. Eight complete public Post Body entries accepted; sold-out watch party and closure held. Representative long listing and detail bodies match exactly. 50 Bowery comes from the publisher and exact NYC PAD.
source_notes.radegast_hall_brooklyn_ny: The ordinary homepage advertises a public Amelia widget. Its shipped JS documents the anonymous GET /events, bookings=false, range=future and page. Both native pages were captured at the site’s 60-second crawl delay. Full descriptions and periods are native; show=false/nonapproved, expired, empty/location-only descriptions and inverted periods are held. Global UTC is a misconfigured site default: client timezone conversion is disabled and publicly rendered clocks corroborate NYC wall time. The native location coordinates are discarded. Bier Haus street is the official licensed alternate premises address 186 Berry.
source_notes.greenbelt_conservancy_staten_island_ny: The official sigreenbelt.org homepage returns404, but its verified Eventbrite organizer is accessible as normal public HTML. Its NEXT_DATA manifest reports exactly5 upcoming entries, no more pages and no load failure. Detail basicInfo validates organizer10628899098 and organization170711247025; local/UTC dates agree and detail end times replace the organizer cards' misleading end=start values. Preserve the complete publisher overview plus all native text modules. Orienteering has a complete96-character overview and an explicitly empty text-module array, so its available native description is complete. All5 details and the final manifest are reviewed before any rows release. Only the3 exact reviewed duplicate Parks guid/registration-ID pairs are assigned away from Parks; other Greenbelt programs remain with Parks.
